description: Manage the user's own MIND profile, public-chat prompt, and model preferences — bio, display name, the system prompt used at their public /m/{username} chat surface, and their default LLM model. This is account/identity settings, not knowledge-graph content — for what MIND knows about the user, use mind_context or mind_query instead. Actions: get/update (profile fields), get_chat_prompt/set_chat_prompt, get_thought_prompt/set_thought_prompt, get_model/set_model/list_models. 'No custom prompt set' on get_chat_prompt/get_thought_prompt means the platform default applies, not that chat is unconfigured — call list_models before set_model if unsure a model id is valid, since an unrecognized id fails at the provider, not here.

action.description: Action: get/update profile, get/set chat/thought prompts, get/set/list LLM models

username.description: Username for get action (defaults to current user)

name: mind_profile
